name: Hinosukui
source:
"My precious doll, please give birth to a cute child."

Shen Jin's subordinate. A mukade monster that seduces men with her charm and devours their flesh. A man is just food, nothing more, nothing less. She likes beautiful young women and makes them lay eggs. These eggs feed on their negative emotions and amplifying desires before hatching. They then proceed to eat their mother's body and transport the nutrients to Hinosukui.

She is aiming for a miko, and has set her sights on Minami Asako.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_hinosukui.png]official website[/url]]
